attributes.title: ASMBS Annual Meeting 2027
attributes.venue: Walt Disney World Swan and Dolphin Resort
attributes.organizer: American Society for Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery
attributes.summary:
The American Society for Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery meets at the Walt Disney World Swan and Dolphin Resort in Orlando from June 27 to July 1, 2027. The theme for this edition is "Elevating Our Future, Enhancing Our Specialty."

The meeting serves the metabolic and bariatric surgery field, with the program centered on obesity care. ASMBS had published the dates, venue and theme when we checked. Pricing, credit hours and travel details sit on separate tabs of the meeting site, so check them there before you register.
